{{External|rs|rsc=Willow Logs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Willow logs |image = [[File:Willow logs.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = Logs cut from a willow tree. |value = 40 |weight = 2.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1519 }} [[File:Willow logs detail.png|130x130px|left]] '''Willow logs''' are logs, which can be cut from [[willow tree]]s using the [[Woodcutting]] [[skill]]. Cutting willow logs from a willow tree requires an [[axe]] and level 30 [[Woodcutting]] and grants 67.5 Woodcutting [[experience]] per log. Players can burn willow logs using the [[Firemaking]] skill and a [[tinderbox]]. This requires level 30 Firemaking and grants 90 Firemaking experience per log. [[Members]] may also use the [[Fletching]] skill and a [[knife]] to carve willow logs into [[arrow shaft]], [[willow shortbow (u)]], [[willow longbow (u)]], [[willow shield]]s or [[willow stock]]s. This requires levels 30, 35, 40, 42 and 39 Fletching respectively and grants 15, 33.3, 41.5, 83 and 22 experience. However, you need 2 willow logs for the willow shield. Willow logs are also used to travel to [[Varrock]] using the [[Balloon transport system]]. Willows can be a very cost-effective way of getting to 99 Firemaking. It takes no more than {{formatnum:{{Items Needed|Goal= 99|Level= 30|ItemXp= 90}}}} willows to get from 30-99 Firemaking. 6 willow logs can be used to light an [[Abyssal lantern (willow logs)|Abyssal lantern]], requiring 30 Firemaking.
